propositions: A Pass-2 finding flagging a plan-vs-code discrepancy during execution review is a false positive when the plan's directed work has already been completed (e.g., plan directs removal of symbol X, agent removed it, re-review incorrectly flags missing X).
An on-target veto must drop such findings only when execution_review=True AND current_state_satisfies_plan_goal=yes AND the finding's criteria belong to registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED cohort.
The veto is cohort-restricted to code-grounded verifiers (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) because present-state code satisfaction checks require tool access; single-turn tool-less verifiers cannot fire the veto.
The orchestrator must deterministically force current_state_satisfies_plan_goal to na for non-grounded findings before kernel invocation, preventing veto escape in non-grounded cohorts.
